summary.name: VisDoc (AiBiao)
summary.one_liner: A Chinese-language online AI tool that generates charts, knowledge cards, single-page PPTs, illustrations and documents from natural-language input or uploaded Excel data.
use_cases: Turning a sentence or pasted data into a chart
Creating charts from an uploaded Excel file
Drafting work reports or product plans with AI
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an AI text-to-chart feature that generates 10+ chart types, including list, matrix, pyramid, funnel and parallel charts, from a natural-language description. Users can also enter data or upload Excel and choose a chart type such as bar, line or radar, plus colors, with the page claiming generation in about 30 seconds. A card tool produces knowledge cards and posters after choosing a model and style. Other modules cover single-page PPT creation with PPTX download, AI illustration from a sentence, and AI document drafting from keywords or an outline.
notable: Excel upload with selectable chart type and colors
Bundles charts, cards, PPT, illustrations and documents in one AI content suite
caveats: The page does not state what is free versus paid; it links to a pricing page only by name
Page text is mostly marketing; specific limits are not given
